meta.title: Workspace MCP
meta.description: Reads .dsh/mcp.json from each session's workspace and mounts every declared MCP server as a session-scoped MCP client (mcp__<server>__<tool>). No per-project profile needed.

config.fileName: Declaration file path, relative to the workspace root.
config.watch: Watch the declaration file and remount the MCP servers of live sessions after it changes.
config.startupTimeoutMs: Maximum time to wait for the initial connection and tool discovery before letting the session continue.
config.allowStdio: Allow stdio MCP servers. This lets a workspace file execute arbitrary local commands, so it is off by default; enable it only for workspaces you trust.
config.stdioAllowlist: Optional guard rail: when non-empty, a stdio command must equal one entry or live below one entry.
config.mountInSubagents: Also mount the workspace's MCP servers for subagent children. Off by default so delegated agents do not spawn duplicate servers.
config.toolCallTimeoutMs: Default timeout for each MCP tool call; a server entry may override it.
